title: Effectiveness of formal objects when X' -> S is separated
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file artin.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: A formal object xi = (R, xi_n) is either over U' (handled by the effectiveness equivalence) or over W; in the latter case the non-adic morphism Spf(R) -> W is corrected by passing to the I-adic formal spectrum Spf'(R) cut out by the preimage of W_red; the truncations xi_n algebraize to morphisms Spec(R/I^n) -> W_n, assemble into the adic hat x, and the base-changed formal modification is algebraized by the main dilatation theorem and Grothendieck's algebraization to produce x' : V' -> X' and the triple (Z, u', hat x) in F(V).
